programs.title: It Came from Outer Space
programs.desc: Richard Carlson stars as an astronomer who sees an alien craft land. But nobody believes him - until the cloning starts in Jack Arnold's science-fiction classic.

programs.title: Brian and Charles
programs.desc: Heartwarming comedy written by and starring David Earl and Chris Hayward. A lonely inventor creates himself an AI robot friend. But what happens when his companion wants to move on.

programs.title: The Martian Interview Special
programs.desc: Director Ridley Scott talks about making his science-fiction survival adventure starring Matt Damon.

programs.title: The Martian
programs.desc: Matt Damon stars in Ridley Scott's drama about an astronaut who accidentally gets left behind on Mars. Oops. How will he survive and how on earth can he get home.

programs.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
programs.desc: Taron Egerton returns as the newest recruit to the stylish secret agency Kingsman for more ass-kicking comedy action. A star-studded cast includes Julianne Moore and Elton John.

programs.title: Chopper
programs.desc: Darkly comic, quasi-true crime biopic starring Eric Bana as notorious Australian criminal Mark 'Chopper' Read who, among other things, got a fellow inmate to chop off his ears.
